expected.measurementInterpretation: Unavailable means no prior measurement, not zero. RMS describes the magnitude of the recurrent coordinates. Sensory fill is a separate field estimate, not the encoded text-input signal. L2 distance is the straight-line distance between the two recurrent state vectors, not path length, speed or a causal effect of writing. Comparing two interval distances requires a recorded value for each. Two observations do not establish the intervening path, a cause, or a felt state.
